ActionLog.title: ActionLog
ActionLog.description: Log of an autonomous action performed by the security AI agent.

id.description: Unique identifier of the action log entry.

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this action log.

toolName.description: Name of the security tool or action executed.

status.description: Status of the execution: SUCCESS, FAILED, RUNNING, or RETRYING.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the event occurred. Must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp. Must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

SecurityChat.title: SecurityChat
SecurityChat.description: Security discussion session or tool consultation.

id.description: Unique identifier of the chat session.

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this chat.

title.description: Title or topic of the security conversation.

lastMessage.description: Snippet of the most recent message.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the last message. Must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp. Must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

SecurityProject.title: SecurityProject
SecurityProject.description: User security project or vulnerability audit workspace.

title.description: Title of the project or repo.

category.description: Security domain (e.g., OSINT, Recon, Scanner, Defense).

/users/{userId}/action_logs/{logId}.description: Autonomous action logs for a user.

/users/{userId}/security_chats/{chatId}.description: Security chat history for a user.

/users/{userId}/security_projects/{proje.description: Security projects and repos for a user.
